name: table-craft-workspace
description: Workspace root for the table-craft desktop app, its core and its datasource plugins

scripts.test:smoke: bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && TABLE_CRAFT_SMOKE=1 vitest run test/e2e --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:smoke:db: bun test/db/up.ts && bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && TABLE_CRAFT_SMOKE=1 TABLE_CRAFT_SMOKE_DATABASES=1 vitest run test/e2e --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:smoke:packaged: bun run desktop:package:dir && TABLE_CRAFT_SMOKE=1 TABLE_CRAFT_APP_EXECUTABLE=$(bun packages/desktop/scripts/packaged-executable.ts) vitest run test/e2e/packaged.smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:smoke:packaged:db: bun test/db/up.ts && bun run desktop:package:dir && TABLE_CRAFT_SMOKE=1 TABLE_CRAFT_SMOKE_DATABASES=1 TABLE_CRAFT_APP_EXECUTABLE=$(bun packages/desktop/scripts/packaged-executable.ts) vitest run test/e2e/packaged.smoke.test.ts
scripts.readme:media: TABLE_CRAFT_DATABASES=postgres,redis bun test/db/up.ts && bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && TABLE_CRAFT_SMOKE=1 TABLE_CRAFT_README_MEDIA=1 vitest run test/readme --no-file-parallelism
scripts.desktop: bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && bun run --cwd packages/desktop start
scripts.desktop:package: bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && bun run --cwd packages/desktop package
scripts.desktop:package:dir: bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && bun run --cwd packages/desktop package:dir
